events.title: 4 ASD Kids Art Exhibition and Auction
events.description: An art exhibition showcasing the creative work of children on the autism spectrum, featuring an auction to support the young artists. A meaningful event focused on neurodiversity and community creativity.

events.title: Chess Get Together at Southport Library
events.description: A relaxed, recurring community meetup where people of all skill levels gather to play chess. An excellent environment for meeting locals in a quiet, intellectual setting.

events.title: English Language Conversation – Gold Coast Student Hub
events.description: A social session focused on improving language skills through natural, open conversation. It attracts a diverse group of locals and students, fostering cross-cultural connections.
